text: Alright hockey junkies, welcome back to the weekly rundown where the standings are tighter than a Gordie Howe hat trick attempt! Mon-Q is clinging to the top spot, but it's a three-way logjam with JeE-DeY and Frank's team breathing down Torida Té's neck, all tied at 327 points, proving that consistency is king in this league. The biggest mover this week is a bit of a crowd with a few teams jockeying for position, but let's give a shout-out to Francis Barrière's Green Jackets and Vincent Daigle's Deagle's Team, both making solid climbs, proving their early season acquisitions are starting to pay off. Don't look now, but the bottom of the barrel is heating up too, with Philippe Guite's Lepetitpeep's squad and Elouan T's Les grosses de Brossard showing signs of life, meaning no one is safe from the dreaded last-place curse. Keep your eyes peeled next week as I predict a major shake-up in the top five, with Louis Do's LMD looking like he's gearing up for a serious run.
